plan.summary: BRO-4371: seven shows have a bwwExcerpt cut short by the BWW roundup parser at a digit-leading outlet name. Rewrite those excerpts from the private BWW archive (and-then-the-rodeo, bigfoot, bloodlove, disruption, jerome, whoopi-monologues, winters-tale). Dry run on the full archive found exactly these 7 files, bwwExcerpt only, no fullText.
steps: Run repair-bww-digit-outlets.js with --write --expect=7. It fails the run unless exactly 7 files were repaired with no write-guard refusals.

actions.description: Repair the 7 corrupted BWW excerpts from the archive
